svg.title: The passenger flagged at the Halt enters School No. 3 as Riju compares attendance systems.
svg.desc: The same young passenger flagged on page 15 enters School No. 3 with a rail ticket beside a school satchel. Maroon, green and blue registers sit beside a biometric scanner while flood marks and the limited shared laboratory remain visible.
svg.text: Page 16, panel 1 · Wide eye-level establishing shot across verandah classroom and courtyard

text.tspan: The team follows the same rail passenger into School
No. 3 and finds paper and electronic attendance
